- Clearly arranged start screen with all important information (status, pills taken and remaining, start and end of intake, pills forgotten, ...)
- Reminder to buy new pill pack(s)
- Mark all pills as taken afterwards
- Calendar overview with past and future pills taken
- Extended calendar view (month and week)
- Additional information can be stored (emotions,
strength of periods, complaints, ...)
- All common pack sizes are supported (21/7, 24/4, 26/2 and 28/0)
- Customize reminder text and sound according to your preferences.
- Reminder time freely selectable
- Freely selectable first day of the week

Premium functions:

- Skip pill pause and start directly with new blister
- Pill intake timeline
- Create your own notes 
- Create additional reminders for e.g. gynecologist appointment
- Always have an eye on your weight with a clear chart and many setting options.
- Create pictures and polls in community forum posts
- Code lock before app start (code or Touch-ID, Face-ID)
- Change event colors in calendar for start and end of pill, 
pill days, as well as for days with additional information
- No advertising
- Change App Theme
